name: grigora-commerce-sdk
description: Grigora Commerce SDK monorepo: headless core, drop-in UI, payment adapters, React and Vue wrappers, and the CDN bundle.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @grigora/commerce-core && npm run build -w @grigora/commerce-ui && npm run build -w @grigora/commerce-adapter-stripe && npm run build -w @grigora/commerce-adapter-razorpay && npm run build -w @grigora/commerce-react && npm run build -w @grigora/commerce-vue && npm run build -w @grigora/commerce
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run size
